import ast
import pathlib
import sqlite3

root = pathlib.Path('.')
queries = {}
for version in ('old', 'new'):
    tree = ast.parse((root / f'{version}_reader.py').read_text())
    queries[version] = ast.literal_eval(tree.body[0].value)
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.executescript((root / '001_initial.sql').read_text())
db.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', (1, 'Example User'))

def check(stage, expected):
    for version, query in queries.items():
        try:
            rows = db.execute(query).fetchall()
            assert rows == [(1, 'Example User')], rows
            works = True
            result = f'OK {rows"'!r}'"'
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
            works = False
            result = f'ERROR: {exc}'
        print(f'{stage}: {version} reader: {result}')
        assert works == expected[version], (stage, version, result)

check('initial schema', {'old': True, 'new': False})
db.executescript((root / '002_up.sql').read_text())
check('after up / before down', {'old': False, 'new': True})
db.executescript((root / '002_down.sql').read_text())
check('after down', {'old': True, 'new': False})
print('PASS: all 6 compatibility checks matched; sample data survived up/down.')
PY"
